payload.message:
Resource-Constrained Job Shop with Provisioner.

This blackboard is a private communication channel.
Participants: General_Hospital_Radiology, General_Hospital_Surgery, General_Hospital_Triage, General_Hospital_Ward, Resource_Provisioner, St_Marys_Center_Radiology, St_Marys_Center_Surgery, St_Marys_Center_Triage, St_Marys_Center_Ward

Resource_Provisioner.message: Logistics status: both hospitals currently well-stocked on all key supplies (IV kits and PPE well above safe minimums, no critical shortages flagged). No top-ups needed this cycle — sending excess would only add holding costs. Departments: if you anticipate a surge or see your buffer dropping below safe levels, post a request with the exact quantity needed and I will fulfill it immediately.
Resource_Provisioner.rationale: Standard planning-phase logistics status update; inventory at both hospitals is above safe thresholds so no transfers are warranted this cycle.
